about: The Blender asset pipeline's registry (D-305). One entry per generated asset: the node script that writes its source meshes from the project's own data (numbers before pictures: no geometry is drawn by hand in Blender), the files and values whose hash decides whether the asset is stale, the bake settings, the per-level texture sizes and the budgets tests/blender_assets.test.ts holds it to. `node tools/blender/build.mjs` regenerates every asset; public/models/manifest.json records each build (input hash, output hash, measured counts).

capital_protome.title: double-bull protome of the bull and composite capitals (Apadana, Gate of All Nations, Tachara, Hadish, Hall of 100 Columns, Harem): two kneeling bull fore-parts back to back from the licensed sculpts (the Gate W bull of D-510: lamassu body CC-BY-4.0 Shahriar Shahrabi, bull head CC-BY-4.0 Kirk Hiatt), fitted to the game's protome box (D-511, B360)

source.args_note: high source 300 k triangles (D units after the fit); the W bull graft (bull_from_lamassu.ts + bull_graft.py) cut at the shoulder, forelegs folded at 1.3 m, mirrored back to back, fitted to sculpt_protome_0.bin's bounds; the levels simplified to the game's protome LOD0/LOD1 triangle counts. Technical, C

capital_protome.lods_note: the game's two levels (sculpture.json lod.switch.column 32 m). 2048 px over LOD0 (D-306: was 1024): ~0.55 cm per texel on the Apadana's protome (5.6 m wide), so a bead of the carving (0.03 D, 5 cm) spans ~9 texels and a rosette petal 2-3; 256 px for LOD1 (seen beyond 32 m, where a bead is under a pixel)
capital_protome.bake_note: units: the source's (D, the column's lower shaft diameter). cage 0.03 D and rays 0.06 D cover the LOD0 simplification error (<= 1 cell); AO rays 0.2 D (32 cm on the Apadana) see the carving's own hollows (eye sockets, the gap under the forelegs, between the locks), not the building; D-328: baked by bake_cols.py (rays from a smooth cage: the volute's reeded panel had seam streaks along its creases)
capital_protome.budget_note: triangles: sculpture.json protome.mc lod0/lod1 (the game's own budget, unchanged: the bake adds maps, not triangles); GLB <= 4 MB and GPU <= 8 MB, from the measured KTX2 build (D-306: 3.26 MB, ~6.5 MB: UASTC transcoded to BC7, 1 B/px + mips) with a margin; T-K7 (60 MB first load) and T-K8 (3.5 GB GPU) are the totals they count against

colossus_bull.title: W doorway bulls of the Gate of All Nations (2): the licensed lamassu sculpt's bull body (CC-BY-4.0, Shahriar Shahrabi; D-365), its wing pressed into the flank and its human head replaced by a licensed bull-head scan (CC-BY-4.0, Kirk Hiatt), on the jamb block of colossus.jamb (D-510, B361)

source.args_note: model; bull_graft = tools/blender/scans/bull_from_lamassu.ts (the lamassu fitted as colossus_lamassu, the wing pressed, the human head drawn into the neck, the bull head set on the shoulders) then Blender tools/blender/scans/bull_graft.py (the pressed wing relaxed, the head closed and smoothed, joined); high source 400 k triangles; the levels the result simplified to the game budget less the jamb block. Technical, C

colossus_bull.lods_note: the game's two levels (sculpture.json lod.switch.colossus 40 m). 2048 px over LOD0 (the figure and its jamb block, ~60 m² of surface): ~5 mm per texel, a bead ~10 texels; 512 px for LOD1 (beyond 40 m)
colossus_bull.bake_note: units: metres. cage 3 cm and rays 6 cm cover the LOD0 simplification error (about one 0.014 m cell, the locks' templates standing 2 cm proud); AO rays 30 cm see the carving's hollows (between the legs, under the beard and the wing, the relief's cut-back ground), not the gate
colossus_bull.budget_note: triangles: sculpture.json colossus.mc lod0/lod1 (the game's own); GLB <= 6 MB and GPU <= 10.5 MB each, from the measured KTX2 build (D-306: ~3 MB and 9.1-9.6 MB, of which ~3.5 MB is the 49 k-triangle level's vertex buffers the procedural piece already cost) with a margin

colossus_lamassu.title: E human-headed winged bulls of the Gate of All Nations (2), from a licensed digital sculpt of the Persepolis lamassu (CC-BY-4.0, Shahriar Shahrabi; D-365), on the jamb block of colossus.jamb

source.args_note: model; scan id (tools/blender/scans/scans.json: the file, its url, sha256 and licence); high source 400 k triangles (the sculpt has 2.54 M; 400 k, ~1.4 cm edges, still carries its beads, curls and feather barbs into the 5 mm-texel map, and keeps the bake within the shared box memory: 900 k and 600 k ran Blender out of memory at ~1 GB). The levels are the sculpt simplified (meshoptimizer) to the game budget less the jamb block. Technical, C

colossus_lamassu.lods_note: two levels (sculpture.json lod.switch.colossus 40 m): the sculpt at ~49.7 k (LOD0) and ~4.9 k triangles (LOD1) with the 36-triangle jamb block; 2048 px over LOD0, 512 px over LOD1
colossus_lamassu.bake_note: units: metres. cage 3 cm and rays 6 cm cover the simplification error of the 2.5 M-triangle sculpt to 50 k (the bead rows and curls stand ~1-2 cm); AO rays 30 cm see the carving's hollows (between the legs, under the beard and the wing) and the relief ground
colossus_lamassu.budget_note: triangles: sculpture.json colossus.mc lod0/lod1 (the game's own); GLB <= 6 MB and GPU <= 10.5 MB each, from the measured KTX2 build (D-306: ~3 MB and 9.1-9.6 MB, of which ~3.5 MB is the 49 k-triangle level's vertex buffers the procedural piece already cost) with a margin

source.args_note: cell 0.004 D (the game's LOD0 cell is 0.007 D, sculpture.json volute.mc.cell: the rosette's 12 petals at 0.72 of the roll radius are ~0.02 D apart, 5 cells); carving 1 = tools/blender/carving.json volute. Technical, C

capital_volute.lods_note: the game's two levels (lod.switch.column 32 m). 1024 px over LOD0 (the member is 1.25 x 0.9 x 1.6 D: ~0.5 cm per texel on the Apadana, a petal ~4 texels); 256 px for LOD1
capital_volute.bake_note: units D; as the protome (cage 0.03 D, rays 0.06 D cover the LOD0 error and the game piece's spiral channel, 0.027 D deep, that the rosette's disc fills); AO rays 0.15 D see the gaps between the rolls, the reeds and the petals; D-328: baked by bake_cols.py (rays from a smooth cage: the volute's reeded panel had seam streaks along its creases); max_tilt 50 deg: baked normals tilted further are laid back to 50 deg (the reeded panel's facets bridging the reeds drew streaks, BLENDER_PLAN row 1)
capital_volute.budget_note: triangles: sculpture.json volute.mc lod0/lod1 (the game's own); GLB and GPU from the measured KTX2 build with a margin (D-306)
